top_concerns: Abstract 'outperform state-of-the-art' is unsupported: ImageNet compared only with ThiNet, CIFAR baselines are unstructured methods converted by L1-normalisation and run at MIPP's ratio; TPP/CHIP/HRank cited but not compared; no FLOPs

Theorem 1 (App. C) proves at most existence of a reconstruction function; 'discoverable by gradient descent' and 'MIPP implies re-trainability' are not established, and MI of deterministic continuous activations is ill-defined
No seeds, variance, tables or run counts (collapse rate per bin); results exist only as plots; the 'noisy results' are conceded in Section 5
MI estimator is a loss comparison of a 1500-iteration MLP with a briefly re-trained one, with no sensitivity study; no pruning cost, FLOPs or latency reported
Per-layer widths rather than MI may explain the advantage: no control that transplants MIPP's ratios onto a simple criterion or guards baselines against layer collapse
notes: Hard to follow or ambiguous: (1) Phase 1.5 asks for benchmarks/scout/coverage/novelty script runs but the 12-query budget and the arXiv-only scope made the baseline scout (needs numbers from abstracts) low-yield for a pruning paper whose baselines are mostly peer-reviewed; I ran fingerprint, 6 counted searches, similarity and verify only, and disclosed the rest. (2) The skill says reviewers must not read each other's reports but all five passes share one context, so independence is only procedural. (3) The 0-100 composite (49.2, band 2) and the rating-based starting point (3) disagreed by one band right at the edge; the EIC rules say not to depart without a named verified issue, which worked but makes the final decision sensitive to rounding (EIC-weighted rating 2.56). (4) The ICLR venue label for final Overall 3 is '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}', which is hard to read next to the skill's own 1-6 vocabulary. (5) The Phase 1.6 report check is defined as a check of drafted reports, but in a single-context run the drafts and checked reports coincide, so I recorded only changes made while writing. (6) Shell commands containing variables or loops were blocked in this environment, so scripts were run one per call. (7) Extraction garbled equations (Eq. 1, App. C), so Theorem 1 could only be assessed at the level of its prose steps.
